title: "STOP GETTING COMPUTER DEGREES" - Sam Altman's SHOCKING Interview
summary: Clips of Sam Altman in Tokyo on competitive-programming rankings, skills to learn, and AI's future; the title misattributes a 'stop getting degrees' quote.

assertions.quote: our internal benchmark is now around 50 and maybe we'll hit number one by the end of this year

verdicts.note: In 2025 OpenAI and Google models reached gold-medal IOI/ICPC-level performance, consistent with the prediction; competitive programming differs a lot from production engineering.

assertions.quote: just start using these tools start incorporating them into the way that you work

verdicts.note: A slogan about future labor competition, not a testable claim; plausible but unmeasured.

assertions.quote: the skills that you need in that world are figuring out what people want sort of Creative Vision quick adaptability

verdicts.note: Plausible economic logic and widely argued, but not measured; execution, distribution and maintenance still matter.
